ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) localized features creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base dark pigmentation across entire fluke. High-intensity pixel mappings are localized as discrete linear segments (rake marks) across the center and lobes, and circular clusters (rosettes) concentrated at distal tips and the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude topographical variance. Right lobe (viewer perspective) trailing edge shows extreme serration with deep, jagged gaps. Left lobe shows continuous, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a convex trajectory. Trailing edges follow a non-linear, jagged trajectory due to significant structural interruptions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel regions located primarily on distal lobe tips and areas bordering the central notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the ventral dark field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural tissue loss (chipping) on the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective); extensive healed rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely irregular 'saw-tooth' profile on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the relatively intact left lobe.
